planned_smoke.scene: Existing 39-block Overworld verification scene: floor x/z -3..2 at y 0; dirt cube(1,1,1), oak-plank column(2,1,2)/(2,2,2). Neutral standing start(.5,1,-2.5), dimensions 0.6 x 1.8, initial degree look zero, default sensitivity 0.5, inversion/smooth/scoping false; final entry must confirm/admit this exact setup.
steps: Record actual build/window/foreground context; launch normal visible window and inspect scene presentation.
Establish actual capture; make first captured move and a subsequent move, recording the discard then real raw-degree view response.

Hold forward through multiple distinct simulation ticks, then release; check held-state clearing and lack of additional input acceleration (inertia may remain). Repeat backward/strafe and an opposing-key combination within the floor.
Align to the dirt cube, hold toward it and observe collision without penetration; perform ground jump and observe vertical motion/landing.
Press Escape to release; click to recapture and confirm first-move rearming.

Lose focus while a movement key is held, release it in the other app, return/recapture and confirm no stuck held input; record actual Native.status transitions and continued bounded simulation semantics.
Close while captured; verify pointer/focus recovery, cleanup/process exit/listener release, then reopen. With Session integration also verify view/body/support restore and ephemeral keys/mouse reset.
Compare representative frames/actions with pinned Java 26.3 using matched admitted scene/settings; retain material differences and exact limited scope.
